title: Compact QCoh derived objects are perfect
statement: For a Noetherian scheme X with derived categories on X and every open U, every compact object P of schemeDerivedQCohCategory X is perfect: Scheme.IsPerfect X P.obj.

proof.text: Install derivedQCohDirectSums X. The supported quasi-coherent property with support Set.univ supplies the triangulated structure on D_QCoh(X); the support condition is vacuous. Quasi-coherent cohomology is invariant under isomorphism, by applying homology to the isomorphism. Install schemeDerivedQCohClosedUnderCoproducts for every universe-u index, so the explicitly supplied ambient sums belong to the full subcategory.

Apply supported_derived_generated_perfect with excluded open empty. It gives a perfect generator G and, for the given P, a tower starting at zero, whose successive cones are sums of shifts of G, and the final telescope triangle. G is compact by perfectObjectCompact.

Apply compact_generator_ambient_thick to this supplied tower, with compact objects G and P. It places P.obj in the ambient triangulated envelope of the singleton G.obj. The explicit tower avoids any assumption on the relative sizes of the Hom and coproduct universes.

Use perfect_thick_closure to supply shifts, two-out-of-three and biproduct summands. The proved private helper perfect_thick_property packages these as a triangulated property stable under retracts. Isomorphism invariance follows by composing each local representative with restriction of the isomorphism. For a retract E of F, complete its split monomorphism to a triangle; the last arrow is zero, so F is isomorphic to E plus its cone. Biprod-summand closure gives perfectness of E. Zero is a retract of G. Mathlib ObjectProperty.triangEnvelope_le_iff then makes the singleton envelope of G lie in perfectSubcategory X; apply this inclusion to P.obj.

proof_origin.place: Alternative compact-generator proof using Tags 09SN, 094A and 09SP, and the existing perfect thick-closure theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem compact_isPerfect_of_isNoetherian (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [hOpen : ∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    ∀ P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, IsCompactObject P → Scheme.IsPerfect X P.obj
